description.zh: 系统版本黑名单列表，英文逗号隔开。
description.en: The blacklist of system versions, separated by commas (,).

description.zh: 是否允许移动网络下载升级包，取值：**Y | N**。
description.en: Specifies whether to allow downloading upgrade packages over a mobile network. Valid values: **Y | N**.

description.zh:
是否强制夜间升级，取值：**Y | N**。

与强制升级不能同时选择是（Y）。
description.en:
Specifies whether to force a night upgrade. Valid values: **Y | N**.

This parameter and IsForceUpgrade cannot both be set to Y at the same time.

description.zh: 是否强制升级，取值：**Y | N**。
description.en: Specifies whether to force an upgrade. Valid values: **Y | N**.
Specifies whether this is a milestone version. Valid values: **Y | N**.

description.zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最大版本versioncode
description.en: The maximum version code of the OTA SDK allowed.

description.zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最小版本versioncode
description.en: The minimum version code of the OTA SDK allowed.

description.zh: 允许移动网络下载的包的最大限制，单位为M，在允许移动网络下载包的情况下，大于该限制的包也不会自动下载。
description.en: The maximum size of packages allowed for download over a mobile network, in MB. When mobile network download is allowed, packages larger than this limit are not automatically downloaded.

description.zh: 夜间升级下载类型。1表示WIFI下下载，2表示任全网下载。
description.en: The download type for night upgrades. A value of 1 indicates download over Wi-Fi only. A value of 2 indicates download over any network.

description.zh: 夜间升级是否允许取消，取值：**Y | N**。
description.en: Specifies whether the night upgrade can be canceled. Valid values: **Y | N**.

description.zh: 夜间升级时是否给出提示框，取值：**Y | N**。
description.en: Specifies whether to display a prompt dialog box during a night upgrade. Valid values: **Y | N**.
The release notes for the version.

description.zh:
升级包列表，包括全量包和增量包，格式为`baseVersion|romUrl,baseVersion|romUrl`。

其中，**baseVersion**为基准版本，

- 如果是全量包，则基准版本为0。
- 如果是增量包，则基准版本为基准的系统版本号。
description.en:
The list of upgrade packages, including full and incremental packages, in the format `baseVersion|romUrl,baseVersion|romUrl`.

**baseVersion** is the baseline version.

- If the package is a full package, set the baseline version to 0.
- If the package is an incremental package, set the baseline version to the baseline system version number.

description.zh: 系统版本白名单，英文逗号隔开。
description.en: The whitelist of system versions, separated by commas (,).

descriptions.zh: > 当用户需要进行FOTA升级（即系统升级）时，需要首先调用此接口创建一个系统版本，然后进行后续的版本测试、灰度、发布。
descriptions.en: > When you need to perform an over-the-air update (system upgrade), invoke this operation to create a system version first, and then proceed with version testing, grayscale, and publishing.
